title:

Benchmark
question:
Was each expense in October Meeting on October 8, 2019 approved?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: event_name = 'October Meeting' where event_date = '2019-10-08'; approved = True means expenses was approved; approved = False means expenses was not approved

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_021
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event AS ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE ev.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting'
  AND ev.XCL_012 LIKE '2019-10-08%'
